comment: The league's sponsors. Each one shows on /sponsors/, in the 'Supported by' strip on the home page and in the footer. Nothing shows while the list is empty. Put logos in src/assets/img/sponsors/ (PNG, WebP or SVG, on a transparent background). Fields: name (required), url (their website), logo, role (short label, e.g. 'Kit sponsor' or 'Awards night partner'), blurb (one or two sentences for the sponsors page), background (the tile behind the logo: "light" (white, the default) for a logo with dark text, "dark" (black) for a logo with white text). Order = display order.

example.name: Example Studio
example.blurb: One or two sentences about who they are and what they do for the league.
